title: 17Sept-Attended RC Upper Northern Beach-Narrabeen
summary: 17th September - Proud to see our dedicated Rtn. Vinod Mirchandani representing the Rotary Club of Bombay Mid-Town at meeting of the Rotary Club of Upper Northern Beaches – Narrabeen in Sydney.
description: 17th September - Proud to see our dedicated Rtn. Vinod Mirchandani representing the Rotary Club of Bombay Mid-Town at meeting of the Rotary Club of Upper Northern Beaches – Narrabeen in Sydney. Vinod highlighted our flagship activities and projects while fostering cross-border goodwill and fellowship.
